versions.changelog: v1.1: Added version field and changelog

Initial release of lead-gen-xpoz — automate social lead generation across Twitter, Instagram, and Reddit.

- Auto-researches your product to create a tailored lead-gen profile and targeted search queries.
- Finds high-intent buyers in live conversations using 1.5B+ indexed posts via Xpoz MCP.
- Scores, ranks, and deduplicates leads; outputs ready-to-personalize outreach drafts.
- Simple setup via xpoz-setup skill and mcporter CLI integration.
